name: MareCet
summary: Studies Malaysia's dolphins, whales and dugongs, raises public awareness and pushes for policy that protects marine habitats.
programmes: Marine mammal research (Langkawi Dolphin Research Project, The Whale Project)
Volunteer research programme and marine excursions
impact: Whale Project 2026 surveyed a 2,000 sq km grid off Langkawi (The Star, June 2026)
beneficiaries: Dolphins, whales and dugongs in Malaysian waters; schoolchildren and coastal communities

organisation.founders: Dr Louisa Ponnampalam and Fairul Izmal Jamal Hisne (marine mammal researchers)
organisation.leadership: Dr Louisa Shobhini Ponnampalam, Chairperson and Executive Director; Fairul Izmal Jamal Hisne, Vice-Chairperson; Ng Jol Ern, Honorary Secretary; Joel Ashervin Zachariah, Treasurer
